author: Dale Philip
description: I visited Pulau Ketam, a car-free island that's built entirely on stilts. There's an auntie there who is renowned for her laksa that she makes with rice instead of noodles. Her place is deep into the residential area of the island. I found it just by chance while going for a wander, and am so glad that I did. It really was soup-erb!
title: Laksa Rice Soup in Pulau Ketam, Malaysia 🇲🇾
